import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Check the distribution of mrt across different introduction pathways
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt) by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.show()

from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Perform ANOVA to test for significant differences in mrt across introduction pathways
groups = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['mrt'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]
f_statistic, p_value = f_oneway(*groups)
f_statistic, p_value

import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Check the relationship between mrt and number of invaded plots
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Minimum Residence Time (mrt) and Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between mrt and invaded niche breadth
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='invaded.niche.breadth', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Minimum Residence Time (mrt) and Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.ylabel('Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.show()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Linear regression for mrt and number of invaded plots
X_mrt_plots = invasion_success[['mrt']].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y_plots = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots'].values
model_plots = LinearRegression()
model_plots.fit(X_mrt_plots, y_plots)
coef_plots = model_plots.coef_[0]
p_value_plots = model_plots.score(X_mrt_plots, y_plots)

# Linear regression for mrt and invaded niche breadth
X_mrt_niche = invasion_success[['mrt']].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y_niche = invasion_success['invaded.niche.breadth'].values
model_niche = LinearRegression()
model_niche.fit(X_mrt_niche, y_niche)
coef_niche = model_niche.coef_[0]
p_value_niche = model_niche.score(X_mrt_niche, y_niche)

coef_plots, p_value_plots, coef_niche, p_value_niche
